negative_reviews.author: Jonathan Marshall
negative_reviews.text: Service and atmosphere was good. Toilets were a pigsty and food was mediocre

negative_reviews.author: Maree
negative_reviews.text: Went for dinner here with 2 others for a birthday meal on Tuesday 7th of July. 30 hours later i was very unwell with obvious food poisoning. Still suffering days later. Wasn't going to leave a public review and instead i just reported it to Aberdeen enviromental health, but after hearing and seeing reviews from others getting sick eating here last week i think it's very important awareness is raised. They need to take this very seriously.
